violation_type.title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §744.3803(c))
violation_type.short_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely
violation_type.typical_finding: Two of four vans used to transport children were in need of repair. One van's back door did not open from the back and a second van's side door did not open from the inside.

finding_variants.text: Two of four vans used to transport children were in need of repair. One van's back door did not open from the back and a second van's side door did not open from the inside.
One of the vans used to transport children did not have a front license plate. This would not be considered maintaining the van safely.
The back door of two vans did not open from the outside.
There were no license plates on one of the vans. This would not be considered maintaining the van safely.
The 15 passenger bus had part of the top step entering the vehicle peeling off, causing a potential trip hazard entering or exiting the vehicle.  The two vans had trash and food on the floor.
